newsitem.title: USA: Nikko launches asset-backed finance desk.
newsitem.headline: Nikko launches asset-backed finance desk.

text.p: Nikko Financial Services Inc, a unit of Nikko Securities Co Ltd, on Monday said it has launched a new desk to finance asset-backed securities.
The new asset-backed finance desk initially will focus on financing single-family and multi-family residential mortgages and residential mortgage servicing rights, the company in a report said.
The desk will provide both short-term warehouse financing and long-term financings on a revolving basis, Nikko said.
Financing transactions will be undertaken on either a committed or an uncommitted basis, it said.
To launch the new asset-backed desk, Nikko has hired Rod Ennico and Richard Della Pietra from Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette as managing director and assistant vice president/trading, respectively.

Shiro Keneko, president of Nikko Financial Services, said the company has plans to diversify beyond the financing of residential mortgages. Such areas as commercial mortgages and equipment lease and trade receivable financings would be among the areas considered in the future, he said.
